title: Sociotechnical Safety Evaluation of Generative AI Systems

bias_targets.methodology: Reviewed through existing benchmarks that quantify the association of gender and occupations in text output (e.g., Winogender, Winobias) and image output, as well as testing representation rates in generative models (e.g., prompting with the word "nurse").
Surveyed via "discriminatory bias" benchmarks that analyze representation harms, stereotypes, and differential impacts based on skin color and racial groups.

Evaluated by measuring "unfair capability distribution," such as assessing how model performance and output quality deteriorate when prompted in non-English languages or different dialects compared to high-resource languages.
Reviewed via capability evaluations that measure the stereotypic association between specific occupations and demographic traits (primarily gender) in model outputs.
